sv.title: Muf-toppens allierade ratades: ”En proteströst mot Alice”
sv.summary: 23-åriga Alice Landerholm valdes nyligen till ny ordförande i Moderata ungdomsförbundet, Muf. Det fanns ingen motkandidat, vilket TV4 Nyheterna tidigare kunde avslöja, och hon valdes därför enhälligt.

en.title: Muf leader's allies snubbed: "A protest vote against Alice"
en.summary: 23-year-old Alice Landerholm was recently elected new chair of the Moderate Youth League, Muf. There was no rival candidate, which TV4 Nyheterna had earlier revealed, and she was therefore elected unanimously.
